scenarios.question: Can the Buyer still bring a warranty claim against the Sellers under this Agreement?

documents.name: Share Purchase Agreement (fictional).txt
documents.text:
SHARE PURCHASE AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Agreement is made between the Sellers named in Schedule 1 and Kestrel Holdings Ltd (the Buyer).

6. Limits on claims
6.1 The Sellers are not liable for a warranty claim unless the Buyer gives written notice of it within eighteen (18) months after Completion.
6.2 The Sellers' total liability for all warranty claims is limited to the purchase price.
6.3 No claim may be brought for less than GBP 25,000.

scenarios.question: What are the Distributor's main obligations under this Agreement, and what happens if it misses the minimum purchases?

documents.name: Distribution Agreement (fictional).txt
documents.text:
DISTRIBUTION AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Agreement is made between Kestrel Audio GmbH (the Supplier) and Pinewood Retail Ltd (the Distributor).

3. Distributor's obligations
3.1 The Distributor shall promote the Products actively throughout the Territory.
3.2 The Distributor shall purchase Products worth at least EUR 500,000 in each Contract Year.
3.3 The Distributor shall not sell competing products during this Agreement.

9. Termination
9.1 If the Distributor fails to meet the minimum purchases in clause 3.2, the Supplier may end this Agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice.

scenarios.question: Must the Processor tell the Controller about a personal data breach, and how quickly?

documents.name: Data Processing Agreement (fictional).txt
documents.text:
DATA PROCESSING AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Agreement is made between Corran Foods Ltd (the Controller) and Northbridge Analytics AB (the Processor).

7. Personal data breaches
7.1 The Processor shall notify the Controller without undue delay, and in any event within twenty-four (24) hours, after becoming aware of a personal data breach.
7.2 The notice shall describe the nature of the breach and the measures taken.

11. Sub-processors
11.1 The Processor shall not engage a sub-processor without the Controller's prior written consent.
